# SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level 17 Hide in Plain Sight widening
# fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level-1..level-16
# hybrid chassis (tests/sd18_ranger_level16_improved_evasion.rs, the loop's
# most recent Ranger ceiling) to Ranger level 17 as chosen input only. It
# names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It is the level-16 fixture with the class level bumped -- no new
# choice selections are exercised, since the level-17 "Special" column
# entry (Hide in Plain Sight, verified independently against three primary
# sources -- d20pfsrd, the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, and
# legacy.aonprd.com, all agreeing byte-for-byte on the class table row and
# on the ability text: "While in any of his favored terrains, a ranger of
# 17th level or higher can use the Stealth skill even while being
# observed.") is an automatic, no-choice grant mirroring Camouflage's own
# idiom exactly: a bounded +0 identity/recognition record only, since no
# terrain-classification engine and no Stealth-check-execution engine
# exists anywhere in this codebase.
#
# Everything else carries over from the level-16 fixture unchanged. No
# terrain-classification engine and no Stealth-check-execution engine
# exists in this codebase, so no hide-while-observed resolution is
# fabricated; the fixture makes no such claim.
